notes.title: First major bug-fix update!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everybody! [/p][p]Here comes the first major bug-fix update! (Yesterday I also uploaded a quick patch)[/p][p][b]Problems fixed:[/b][/p][p]- Strange flower recoloring[/p][p]- Object duplication[/p][p]- Music volume now saves/loads correctly[/p][p]- Achievements are fully fixed - you can now reach 100%![/p][p]-Hearts removed from the HUD
[/p][p]And... a new character has been added! [/p][p]It was actually a small bug that the game launched without him, but now he'll visit your shop too. Be gentle though - he's a very sensitive soul.
[/p][p]I also realized the game wasn't fully optimized for low processors, which could cause unpleasant glitches. I'm now working on a low processor mode so everyone can enjoy crafting bouquets smoothly.[/p][p]Best,[/p][p]Iris[/p]

notes.title: 🌸Flowers And Favours is OUT NOW!!!🌼
notes.content:
[p]🌸 55 florals
🎀 16 wraps
🐰 9 adorable customers
🌈 And endless creativity![/p][p]This is my debut game, and I’m so proud of how it turned out! Thank you so much for your support and for enjoying my little game 🥰
[/p][p]Here are the answers to some of the most frequently asked questions:[/p][list][*][p][b]Will there be localization to other languages?[/b]
Yes! Localization will be added in a few months. Please let me know which languages you'd like to see the most[/p][/*][*][p][b]Will there be Steam Deck support?[/b]
Yes! I plan to add it in the first major update. I'm a Steam Deck user myself, so it's very important to me[/p][/*][*][p][b]Will there be content updates?[/b]
Absolutely! I'm planning to add more flowers, greenery, wraps, and accessories. It's honestly the most fun part of development, haha.[/p][/*][*][p][b]How can I support your development?[/b]
Please leave reviews and share the game with your friends - it helps a lot![/p][/*][*][p][b]Nintendo Switch release?[/b]
Also planned, but I can't give a definite date just yet :([/p][/*][/list]
